# Shift4 Announces Date of Third Quarter Earnings Results and Upcoming Investor Conference Participation


Oct 22, 2026 4:30 PM EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_91758df1d499f8354a690facd8fbd131/shift4/news/2026-10-22_Shift4_Announces_Date_of_Third_Quarter_Earnings_309.pdf)


CENTER VALLEY, Pa.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) today announced the date for the release of its third quarter 2026 financial results.


**Q3 2026 Earnings Conference Call**


Shift4 will release its third quarter 2026 financial results pre-market open on Thursday, November 5, 2026. Management will also host a conference call at 8:30am ET to review these results.


Conference Call Details


Toll-free dial-in:


+1-888-660-6196


Toll dial-in:


+1-929-203-1911


Conference ID:


FOURQ326


The earnings conference call will also be webcast and interested parties can join the webcast through Shift4’s website at:[https://investors.shift4.com](https://investors.shift4.com/)


X Spaces Simulcast


In addition to the webcast, an audio of the earnings call will be simulcast via X Spaces. Follow @Shift4 on X for additional information on how to access the simulcast.


**Upcoming Investor Conference Participation**


November 9, 2026


– Management will be available for one-on-one and small group meetings at the Citi’s 15th Annual FinTech Conference.


November 10, 2026


– Management will participate in a fireside chat at the KBW FinTech Ecosystem Conference beginning at 1:10PM ET. Management will also be available for one-on-one and small group meetings. The fireside chat will be webcast live and interested parties can join the webcast at:[https://investors.shift4.com](https://investors.shift4.com/)


December 7, 2026


– Management will participate in a fireside chat at the Wells Fargo TMT Conference beginning at 2:15PM PT (5:15PM ET). Management will also be available for one-on-one and small group meetings. The fireside chat will be webcast live and interested parties can join the webcast at:[https://investors.shift4.com](https://investors.shift4.com/)


**About Shift4**


Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) powers the experience economy, enabling businesses to deliver the moments that matter. Transforming how people shop, dine, stay, and play, Shift4’s commerce technology allows for a seamless experience at any scale. From your neighborhood restaurant to the world’s largest event venues, Shift4 handles billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses around the world. For more information, visit[shift4.com](https://www.shift4.com/) .
